entities.name: Tobias El Khazen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Tobias El Khazen was a former Eparch of the Maronite Catholic Archeparchy of Cyprus, Maronite Catholic Archeparchy of Tripoli and the 62nd Maronite Patriarch of Antioch from 1756 to his death in 1766.

As a prominent figure in the Maronite Catholic Church, El Khazen played a crucial role in maintaining the spiritual and cultural traditions of the Maronite community, particularly in the face of Ottoman rule.

His leadership and diplomatic efforts helped to promote Maronite interests and protect the rights of Maronite Catholics in the region.

El Khazen's legacy can be seen in the continued importance of the Maronite Catholic Church in the Middle East and its continued influence on the cultural and religious landscape of the region.

In the words of Pope Pius VI, 'El Khazen was a true son of the Church, a servant of the Lord, and a defender of the faith,' demonstrating the high esteem in which he was held by his contemporaries.
